_: The school-facing page. EVERY FIGURE IS NAMED, NOT TYPED: `figures` entries give (kind, slug, label) and the build resolves each against data/work/**, dying if it cannot — the /impact pattern. Programme rows likewise carry only a slug; name, line, duration and geography are read out of the item file, so this page cannot describe a programme differently from the programme's own page.

masthead.lead: Six programmes, from a four-hour walk inside Delhi to twelve days down a thousand kilometres of river. All of them run for whole cohorts, all of them put a day of work in, and all of them are older than most of the people on them.

frame.alt: A facilitator pointing out across the Yamuna to a small group of students standing on the bank

programmes.head: What a school can book
programmes.lead: Ordered by how long they take. Every one of them opens its own page, where the itinerary, the destinations and the record sit in full.

rows.for: A morning. Whole classes, no travel beyond Delhi.
A day out, a short course, or a longer stay on five acres.
A term or a year inside the school itself, with teacher training.
Two to five days in one of four ecosystems.
Four to five days living in a village, not visiting one.
Twelve days, source to Agra. For a school building a year around it.

outcomes.head: What students come back able to do
outcomes.lead: Not a syllabus. These are the things a cohort can do afterwards that it could not do before, and each one has a page behind it they can be sent to first.

rows.h: Read a reading against its limit
rows.p: The difference between “the air was bad” and “PM2.5 was three times the 24-hour standard of 60”. One is an impression and the other can be argued with in a room full of adults.

rows.h: Tell a measurement from a model
rows.p: Why a national figure is almost always modelled, why a street-level one is almost always measured, and why the two cannot be averaged.

rows.h: Say where a pollutant came from — and where the honest answer stops
rows.p: Two government studies of Delhi's air put the transport share at 6–29 and 17–28 per cent. Holding that as the state of the knowledge, rather than picking the convenient end, is the skill.
Dissolved oxygen is what the river has; BOD is what is being taken out of it. Standing at Wazirabad and then at Okhla makes the two numbers physical.

rows.h: Notice a definition doing the work
rows.p: India's own report says the forest grew; the satellites say it went. Both are right. Finding the definition that makes both true is the whole lesson.

record.head: What is on record
record.lead: Every figure here is read out of the programme's own page. Nothing on this page is a number typed for a brochure.

figures.label: Grassroots partners in the villages themselves

after: Swechha has been doing this since 2000. The schools named on the programme pages are the ones that have gone on record with us — the Shriram Schools, Modern Schools, Vasant Valley School and Pathways World School among them.

No cumulative total is printed here, and that is deliberate. These figures count overlapping cohorts over unaligned periods; a student who walked a CityScape and then went on a Yatra is in two of them, and adding them would double-count children.

logistics.head: How it works
logistics.lead: The parts a coordinator has to plan around, stated plainly.

rows.p: These are designed for a whole class arriving together from one school, not for individuals. A week only lands if everybody goes back to the same corridor.

rows.h: A teacher travels with the group
rows.p: Somebody from the school is on every journey. What they carry back into a classroom is the part we never see.
Two days in a forest and five in the Sunderbans are not the same trip and are not planned as one. A programme that runs to a single fixed length is selling logistics.

rows.h: There is a day of work in it
rows.p: Shramdaan is built into the journeys on purpose. Without it the whole thing is a viewing, and viewings do not change what anybody does afterwards.

rows.h: Dates are set with the school
rows.p: Season decides more than the calendar does: a desert day in May and a Sunderbans day in monsoon are different propositions. Tell us the window and we will say what fits it.
They depend on destination, length and group size, so there is no single price to publish. Ask and you will get a figure for your cohort rather than a range you have to interpret.

ask.head: Talk to the education team
ask.lead: One person reads these. Tell us the year group, roughly how many, what you have in mind and when in the year — that is enough to come back with something specific.
ask.label: Plan a school visit
ask.note: A school that has done two of the four ecosystems has something no single journey can give it.
